method_card.title: Friendships and Personal Qualities
method_card.content:
This lesson covers friendship vocabulary, the qualities you value in a friend, and how to spend time together. Key grammar: the reflexive verb llevarse bien/mal con (to get on well/badly with) and a range of opinion phrases beyond me gusta.

SpanishEnglish
el/la mejor amigo/abest friend
la amistadfriendship
la confianzatrust
el apoyosupport
el respetorespect
fielloyal
comprensivo/aunderstanding
honesto/ahonest
divertido/afun
generoso/agenerous
llevarse bien conto get on well with
llevarse mal conto get on badly with
Creo que / Pienso queI think that
A mi modo de verIn my view (Higher)
desde hace + timefor + time period (Higher)

Grammar focus: reflexive verbs and ser for personality. Llevarse is a reflexive verb: me llevo, te llevas, se lleva, nos llevamos, os lleváis, se llevan. Follow it with con + the person. Use ser for personality: es fiel (she is loyal), es honesto (he is honest). Do NOT use estar for permanent personality traits — está honesto is wrong.

Opinion phrases: Creo que, Pienso que, En mi opinión, A mi modo de ver. These all take a clause directly: Creo que la confianza es lo más importante (I think trust is the most important thing).

Model paragraph: Me llevo muy bien con mi mejor amiga porque es fiel y comprensiva. Creo que la confianza es lo más importante en una amistad. (I get on very well with my best friend because she is loyal and understanding. I think trust is the most important thing in a friendship.)
steps: Learn the key vocabulary for friendships and qualities
Master the reflexive verb llevarse bien/mal con
Use ser for personality traits — never estar
Practice opinion phrases like Creo que and A mi modo de ver

exam_context.frequency: Core topic — friendship and qualities appear across all papers

worked_examples.question: Translate to English: Me llevo bien con mi hermano porque es muy divertido.

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Me llevo bien con = I get on well with. This is a reflexive verb — the me is the reflexive pronoun.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: mi hermano = my brother. porque es muy divertido = because he is very fun. Use ser (es) for personality.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: I get on well with my brother because he is very fun.

worked_examples.question: How would you say 'I think that loyalty is the most important thing'?

steps.label: Step 1
steps.content: Start with an opinion phrase: Creo que (I think that) or Pienso que.

steps.label: Step 2
steps.content: 'the most important thing' = lo más importante. 'loyalty' = la lealtad or use 'ser fiel'.

steps.label: Answer
steps.content: Creo que la lealtad es lo más importante.

bronze.question: Match the Spanish to the English meaning
Match the Spanish adjectives to their English meaning
Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: bien con mi mejor amiga porque

gaps.correct_explain: llevo is the yo form of the reflexive verb llevarse. Me llevo bien con = I get on well with.

wrong.lleva: lleva is the él/ella form. With me you need the yo form → llevo.
wrong.llevan: llevan is the ellos/ellas form (they). The subject is 'I' → me llevo.

gaps.correct_explain: es (she is) — use ser for personality traits, not estar.

wrong.son: son is plural (they are). Mi amiga is singular → es.
wrong.está: está is from estar, used for temporary states, not permanent personality.

bronze.question: Complete the sentence
sentence_parts: porque un buen amigo siempre te

gaps.correct_explain: Creo que = I think that. This is one of the key opinion phrases for GCSE.

wrong.Quiero: Quiero means 'I want', not 'I think'. Use Creo or Pienso.

gaps.correct_explain: importante — adjectives ending in -e do not change for gender.

wrong.importanta: importanta does not exist. Importante ends in -e and does not change for gender.

gaps.correct_explain: apoya is the él/ella form of apoyar (to support). The subject is un buen amigo (he).

wrong.apoyo: apoyo is the yo form (I support). The subject is un buen amigo → apoya.
wrong.apoyan: apoyan is the ellos form (they support). The subject is singular → apoya.

bronze.question: What does 'Nos llevamos bien porque tenemos mucho en común' mean?
options: We get on well because we have a lot in common
We get on badly because we have nothing in common
I get on well with him because we have a lot in common
They get on well because they are very common

bronze.source_text: Mi mejor amigo es muy fiel y siempre me apoya. Creo que la confianza es lo más importante.
model_answers: My best friend is very loyal and always supports me. I think that trust is the most important thing.

silver.question: Complete the sentence
silver.english: We have known each other for five years and we get on very well.
sentence_parts: desde hace cinco años y nos

gaps.correct_explain: conocemos is the nosotros form of conocerse (to know each other). Nos conocemos = we know each other.

wrong.conocen: conocen is the ellos form (they know each other). With nos (we) → conocemos.
wrong.conozco: conozco is the yo form (I know). The subject is 'we' → conocemos.

gaps.correct_explain: llevamos is the nosotros form of llevarse. Nos llevamos bien = we get on well.

wrong.llevo: llevo is the yo form (I). The subject is 'we' → nos llevamos.
wrong.llevan: llevan is the ellos form (they). The subject is 'we' → nos llevamos.

silver.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
silver.sentence: Mi mejor amiga es muy fiel y honesto.
silver.explanation: amiga is feminine, so the adjective must agree: honesta, not honesto.
silver.translation: My best friend (f) is very loyal and honest.

silver.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
silver.english: I get on well with my sister because she is very understanding.

distractor_labels.comprensivo: wrong gender — hermana is feminine, so comprensiva not comprensivo

silver.source_text: A good friend should be loyal and honest. In my opinion, trust is very important.
model_answers: Un buen amigo debe ser fiel y honesto. En mi opinión, la confianza es muy importante.

gold.source_text: In my view, the most important thing in a friendship is trust. A good friend should be loyal, honest and understanding. Sometimes we argue but we always forgive each other quickly.
model_answers: A mi modo de ver, lo más importante en una amistad es la confianza. Un buen amigo debe ser fiel, honesto y comprensivo. A veces discutimos pero siempre nos perdonamos rápidamente.

gold.question: Build the sentence in Spanish
gold.english: We argue sometimes about small things but we always forgive each other.

distractor_labels.discuten: wrong conjugation — discuten is ellos (they). The subject is 'we' → discutimos
distractor_labels.perdonan: wrong conjugation — perdonan is ellos (they). With nos → perdonamos (we)
distractor_labels.pequeños: wrong agreement — cosas is feminine → pequeñas not pequeños

gold.question: Role Play
gold.scenario: You are at a leisure centre in Spain with your exchange partner. They want to know about your friends back home. Answer in Spanish.

bullets.model_answer: Mi mejor amigo es muy divertido y amable. Siempre me hace reír.
bullets.note: ser + personality adjectives with correct agreement

bullets.prompt: Say what you do together and how long you have been friends.
bullets.model_answer: Somos amigos desde hace seis años. Jugamos al fútbol juntos los fines de semana.
bullets.note: desde hace + time period (for X years)

bullets.prompt: Ask your exchange partner if they have a best friend.
bullets.model_answer: ¿Tienes un mejor amigo o una mejor amiga?
bullets.note: question with ¿Tienes...? — remember inverted question mark at the start

bullets.prompt: Say what qualities are important in a friend and give a reason.
bullets.model_answer: Creo que un buen amigo debe ser fiel y honesto porque la confianza es esencial.
bullets.note: opinion phrase + debe ser + qualities + porque + reason

gold.correct_text: A mi modo de ver, lo más importante en una amistad es la confianza y el respeto. Un buen amigo debe ser fiel.

gold.question: Find and fix the grammatical error
gold.sentence: A veces nos peleamos pero siempre nos perdonan rápidamente.
gold.explanation: The subject is nosotros (we) as shown by nos. The verb must be perdonamos (we forgive), not perdonan (they forgive).
gold.translation: Sometimes we fight but we always forgive each other quickly.
